note.zh: 最慢，也最容易撞见路边的故事。
note.en: The slowest road, and the one that keeps stopping you to talk.

note.zh: 山道上骡子比马稳，比驼灵便。
note.en: On mountain tracks a mule outfoots both horse and camel.

note.zh: 沙碛之上，驼比人更知道水在哪里。
note.en: In the sand-sea the camel knows where the water is before you do.

note.zh: 按站走，宿在驿栈，遇事有人商量——但要等它出发。
note.en: Stage by stage, caravanserai to caravanserai, with company to consult — once it deigns to leave.

note.zh: 凭金牌换马，一日数百里。无牌者不得近厩。
note.en: Show the paiza, change horses, eat the miles. Without it, keep away from the stables.

note.zh: 便宜、安全、路线由不得你——他们只走圣地之间。
note.en: Cheap, safe, and not yours to steer: they go between holy places and nowhere else.

note.zh: 地中海的桨帆船，无风也能走。
note.en: A Mediterranean galley makes way even when the wind will not.

note.zh: 船板以椰索缝合，不用一枚铁钉——波罗说他不敢乘。
note.en: Planks sewn with coir, not one iron nail — Polo says he would not sail in one.

note.zh: 四桅十二帆，舱分隔水，破一舱而不沉。
note.en: Four masts, twelve sails, and bulkheads: one holed compartment will not sink her.

note.zh: 御河上舟楫相衔，日夜不绝。
note.en: On the Imperial canal the boats run bow to stern, day and night.
